name: object-s3
description: The object-store plugin for the hosted lane: private file storage on the app's S3 bucket, declared as services.objects and served on the app's own origin. A skill with worked examples: presigned direct upload and download that bypass the API function and data store, owner-scoped keys authorised before signing, size and content-type limits, deleting files with their record, and platform retention. Go handlers over api-go and a web client for web-svelte.
